description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Malcator, adding {C}{C}.
Malcator dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Malcator from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Malcator enters the battlefield, creating a 3/3 Phyrexian Golem creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Phyrexian Golem, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
